comment.body: Thanks for attaching both bootstrapper logs. They show why the GitHub installers stop: 0.98.1 detects a current-user install and 0.98.0 an all-users install (0x81f40001), so they refuse a conflicting install. The remaining issue is that Settings reportedly cannot uninstall either entry. Could you report the exact result/error for each and which scope you want to keep? No additional bootstrapper logs are needed.
